propositions: When context limit is hit during plan review Pass-1, escalation selects a rung target by comparing class resolution against provider inference without considering the run's configured model, causing a provider-qualified run to be relocated to a bare Anthropic model id
A Bedrock-qualified primary model escalates to a bare Anthropic id, and when cfg.model_provider is composed with a bare model, it creates an invalid Bedrock model id like bedrock:claude-opus-4-8
The one-criterion retry substitution on the entry rung executes before escalation is needed because models_at_or_above returns a single-element list of bare model ids for Anthropic primaries
The defect only occurs when the model-class table is unconfigured combined with a provider-qualified cfg.model; configured tables already return correct provider-qualified targets

The fix threads the run's primary model into _rung_target to apply a provider-agreement rule: return the primary verbatim on its own rung if providers differ, drop higher rungs if providers differ and no class table names them
